items.en: I had a job interview yesterday. I was very nervous, but I think it went well.
items.ko: 어제 면접을 봤어요. 많이 긴장했지만 잘 본 것 같아요.

items.en: My best friend got married last weekend. The wedding was beautiful, and everyone was so happy.
items.ko: 지난 주말에 제일 친한 친구가 결혼했어요. 결혼식이 아름다웠고 모두가 정말 행복해했어요.

items.en: I finally cleaned my room this morning. It took three hours, but now it looks great.
items.ko: 오늘 아침에 드디어 방 청소를 했어요. 세 시간이나 걸렸지만 이제 아주 깔끔해요.

items.en: I caught a cold last week. I stayed in bed for two days and drank a lot of tea.
items.ko: 지난주에 감기에 걸렸어요. 이틀 동안 누워 있으면서 차를 많이 마셨어요.

items.en: I tried a new restaurant near my office today. The pasta was amazing, so I want to go again.
items.ko: 오늘 회사 근처 새 식당에 가 봤어요. 파스타가 정말 맛있어서 또 가고 싶어요.
